title: Set up the integral
text: Rotating about the y-axis, the surface area is the integral of $$2\pi x \sqrt{\left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2+\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)^2}$$. Here this is the integral of $$2\pi 3t^2 6t \sqrt{1+t^2}=36\pi t^3 \sqrt{1+t^2}$$ from $$0$$ to $$5$$.

title: Evaluate
text: With $$u=1+t^2$$, the integral becomes $$18\pi$$ times the integral of $$\left(u-1\right) \sqrt{u}$$ from $$1$$ to $$26$$, which equals $$\frac{24\pi}{5} \left(949\sqrt{26}+1\right)$$.
